correctness.rationale: For a cyclic Fq[t]/(f)-module each divisor f_i identifies one invariant submodule. The prefix flag therefore forces any similarity between cyclic matrices with the same ordered diagonal to preserve that flag; orbit-stabilizer in B and local-unit cardinalities prove the exact fixed-word formula. Nonemptiness is given by one Jordan chain on the positions of each eigenvalue. Stirling partitions and a finite binomial EGF give the total count and the j=q dominant-term asymptotic. The actual packaged checker independently enumerates all prescribed diagonals for eleven field/dimension pairs (including GF4) and checks two independent closed forms. Finite tests corroborate but do not replace the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Explicit nilpotent one-block orbit and count are already present in Fresse (2013) and Yip (2013), so neither is claimed new. Brown–Praeger–Giudici (2011) counts cyclic operators preserving only one subspace. The complete mixed-diagonal word-specific Borel orbit formula, all split-polynomial multiplicities, Stirling density and exponential rate were not located in the inspected full texts or other targeted results. Published stronger formulas that automatically imply all these assertions were not found. Equivalent statements in inaccessible early literature remain possible.
residual_risks: Neumann and Praeger (1995) and Wall (1999) full texts were not available for material review, so an equivalent full-flag enumeration in a subsidiary result is a residual bibliographic risk.
General algebraic-group literature may present equivalent regular Borel-orbit parametrizations under different terminology.
The nilpotent single-eigenvalue stratum is already known and is not the originality claim.

value.rationale: The full-flag upper triangular algebra is a canonical family, not an arbitrary slice. The result completely classifies the cyclic locus into Borel conjugacy strata, determines each exact orbit size and each split-polynomial count, and reveals a sharp exponentially vanishing cyclicity density at fixed q. This separates complete-flag stabilization from maximal reducible algebras in the primary literature and is a natural structural and probabilistic classification over every finite field; the previously known nilpotent slice is specifically excluded from the originality claim.
